item.text: The PDFs contain the needed totals on a single “Total” row per year: each school has application count and supported count. I’m extracting those rows across all years and will compute `supported / applications` for each school.

import subprocess, re, glob, os
schools=['CityU','HKBU','LU','CUHK','EdUHK','PolyU','HKUST','HKU']
for path in sorted(glob.glob('/home/user/Documents/Fundings/ecs/ecs*.pdf')):
    text=subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext','-layout',path,'-'], text=True, errors='replace')
    line=None
    for l in text.splitlines():
        if re.match(r'"'^(?:T'"\\s*o\\s*t\\s*a\\s*l|Total)\\b', l.strip()):
            line=l
    if not line:
        print('NO TOTAL',path); continue
    nums=[int(x.replace(',','')) for x in re.findall(r'\\d[\\d,]*', line)]
    print(os.path.basename(path), len(nums), nums[:12], nums[-4:])
    for i,s in enumerate(schools):
        g=nums[i*4:(i+1)*4]
        print(' ',s,g[0],g[2])
    print(' total', nums[32], nums[34])

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, re, glob, os, csv, zipfile, html
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
base=Path('/home/user/Documents/Fundings/ecs')
schools=['CityU','HKBU','LU','CUHK','EdUHK','PolyU','HKUST','HKU']
records=[]
year_totals=[]
for path in sorted(base.glob('ecs*.pdf')):
    m=re.search(r'ecs(\\d{2})\\.pdf"'$'"', path.name)
    if not m: continue
    yy=int(m.group(1)); year=f'20{yy:02d}/{yy+1:02d}'
    text=subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext','-layout',str(path),'-'], text=True, errors='replace')
    line=None
    for l in text.splitlines():
        if re.match(r'"'^(?:T'"\\s*o\\s*t\\s*a\\s*l|Total)\\b', l.strip()):
            line=l
    if not line:
        raise RuntimeError(f'No total row found in {path}')
    nums=[int(x.replace(',','')) for x in re.findall(r'\\d[\\d,]*', line)]
    if len(nums)"'!=36:
        raise RuntimeError(f'"'Unexpected number count in {path}: {len(nums)}')
    for i,s in enumerate(schools):
        app, app_amt, sup, sup_amt = nums[i*4:(i+1)*4]
        records.append({'Year':year,'PDF':path.name,'School':s,'Applications':app,'Supported':sup,'Pass Rate':sup/app if app else None,'Application Amt "'$000'"':app_amt,'Supported Amt "'$000'"':sup_amt})
    app, app_amt, sup, sup_amt = nums[32:36]
    year_totals.append({'Year':year,'PDF':path.name,'Applications':app,'Supported':sup,'Pass Rate':sup/app if app else None,'Application Amt "'$000'"':app_amt,'Supported Amt "'$000'"':sup_amt})

# CSV long format
csv_path=base/'ecs_pass_rates_2015_2023.csv'
with csv_path.open('w', newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['Year','PDF','School','Applications','Supported','Pass Rate'])
    for r in records:
        w.writerow([r['Year'],r['PDF'],r['School'],r['Applications'],r['Supported'],f\"{r['Pass Rate']:.2%}\"])

# Build table data
pass_rows=[]
for yt in year_totals:
    y=yt['Year']
    row=[y]
    for s in schools:
        r=next(x for x in records if x['Year']==y and x['School']==s)
        row.append(f\"{r['Pass Rate']:.1%}\")
    row.append(f\"{yt['Pass Rate']:.1%}\")
    pass_rows.append(row)
pass_table=[['Year']+schools+['Overall']]+pass_rows

counts_header=['Year']
for s in schools:
    counts_header += [f'{s} applications',f'{s} supported',f'{s} pass rate']
counts_header += ['Overall applications','Overall supported','Overall pass rate']
counts_rows=[]
for yt in year_totals:
    y=yt['Year']; row=[y]
    for s in schools:
        r=next(x for x in records if x['Year']==y and x['School']==s)
        row += [r['Applications'],r['Supported'],f\"{r['Pass Rate']:.1%}\"]
    row += [yt['Applications'],yt['Supported'],f\"{yt['Pass Rate']:.1%}\"]
    counts_rows.append(row)
counts_table=[counts_header]+counts_rows

summary=[]
for s in schools:
    rs=[r for r in records if r['School']==s]
    apps=sum(r['Applications'] for r in rs); sup=sum(r['Supported'] for r in rs)
    annual=sum(r['Pass Rate'] for r in rs)/len(rs)
    summary.append([s,apps,sup,f'{sup/apps:.1%}',f'{annual:.1%}'])
summary.sort(key=lambda x: float(x[3].strip('%')), reverse=True)
summary_table=[['School','2015/16-2023/24 applications','Supported','Overall pass rate','Average annual pass rate']]+summary
summary_table += [['All schools',sum(y['Applications'] for y in year_totals),sum(y['Supported'] for y in year_totals),f\"{sum(y['Supported'] for y in year_totals)/sum(y['Applications'] for y in year_totals):.1%}\",'']]

long_table=[['Year','PDF','School','Applications','Supported','Pass Rate','Application Amt "'$000'"','Supported Amt "'$000'"']]
for r in records:
    long_table.append([r['Year'],r['PDF'],r['School'],r['Applications'],r['Supported'],f\"{r['Pass Rate']:.1%}\",r['Application Amt "'$000'"'],r['Supported Amt "'$000'"']])

# Create minimal xlsx
xlsx_path=base/'ecs_pass_rates_2015_2023.xlsx'
worksheets=[('Pass rates',pass_table),('Counts',counts_table),('School summary',summary_table),('Long data',long_table)]

def col_letter(n):
    s=''
    while n:
        n, rem=divmod(n-1,26); s=chr(65+rem)+s
    return s

def sheet_xml(table):
    rows=[]
    for r_idx,row in enumerate(table,1):
        cells=[]
        for c_idx,val in enumerate(row,1):
            ref=f'{col_letter(c_idx)}{r_idx}'
            if isinstance(val,(int,float)) and not isinstance(val,bool):
                cells.append(f'<c r=\"{ref}\"><v>{val}</v></c>')
            else:
                text=html.escape(str(val))
                cells.append(f'<c r=\"{ref}\" t=\"inlineStr\"><is><t>{text}</t></is></c>')
        rows.append(f'<row r=\"{r_idx}\">' + ''.join(cells) + '</row>')
    # column widths
    max_cols=max(len(r) for r in table)
    cols=''.join(f'<col min=\"{i}\" max=\"{i}\" width=\"{18 if i==1 else 15}\" customWidth=\"1\"/>' for i in range(1,max_cols+1))
    return '<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>' + \\
           '<worksheet xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main\" xmlns:r=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships\">' + \\
           f'<cols>{cols}</cols><sheetData>' + ''.join(rows) + '</sheetData></worksheet>'

content_types='''<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>
<Types xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types\">
<Default Extension=\"rels\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml\"/>
<Default Extension=\"xml\" ContentType=\"application/xml\"/>
<Override PartName=\"/xl/workbook.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet.main+xml\"/>
<Override PartName=\"/docProps/core.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.core-properties+xml\"/>
<Override PartName=\"/docProps/app.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.extended-properties+xml\"/>
''' + ''.join(f'<Override PartName=\"/xl/worksheets/sheet{i}.xml\" ContentType=\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.worksheet+xml\"/>' for i in range(1,len(worksheets)+1)) + '\\n</Types>'
rels='''<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>
<Relationships xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships\">
<Relationship Id=\"rId1\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/officeDocument\" Target=\"xl/workbook.xml\"/>
<Relationship Id=\"rId2\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships/metadata/core-properties\" Target=\"docProps/core.xml\"/>
<Relationship Id=\"rId3\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/extended-properties\" Target=\"docProps/app.xml\"/>
</Relationships>'''
wb_sheets=''.join(f'<sheet name=\"{html.escape(name)}\" sheetId=\"{i}\" r:id=\"rId{i}\"/>' for i,(name,_) in enumerate(worksheets,1))
workbook=f'''<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>
<workbook xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main\" xmlns:r=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships\"><sheets>{wb_sheets}</sheets></workbook>'''
wb_rels='<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?><Relationships xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships\">' + ''.join(f'<Relationship Id=\"rId{i}\" Type=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet\" Target=\"worksheets/sheet{i}.xml\"/>' for i in range(1,len(worksheets)+1)) + '</Relationships>'
now=datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()+'Z'
core=f'''<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>
<cp:coreProperties xmlns:cp=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/metadata/core-properties\" xmlns:dc=\"http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/\" xmlns:dcterms=\"http://purl.org/dc/terms/\" xmlns:dcmitype=\"http://purl.org/dc/dcmitype/\" xmlns:xsi=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance\"><dc:creator>Codex</dc:creator><cp:lastModifiedBy>Codex</cp:lastModifiedBy><dcterms:created xsi:type=\"dcterms:W3CDTF\">{now}</dcterms:created><dcterms:modified xsi:type=\"dcterms:W3CDTF\">{now}</dcterms:modified></cp:coreProperties>'''
app='''<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?><Properties xmlns=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/extended-properties\" xmlns:vt=\"http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/docPropsVTypes\"><Application>Codex</Application></Properties>'''
with zipfile.ZipFile(xlsx_path,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    z.writestr('[Content_Types].xml',content_types)
    z.writestr('_rels/.rels',rels)
    z.writestr('xl/workbook.xml',workbook)
    z.writestr('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels',wb_rels)
    z.writestr('docProps/core.xml',core)
    z.writestr('docProps/app.xml',app)
    for i,(_,table) in enumerate(worksheets,1):
        z.writestr(f'xl/worksheets/sheet{i}.xml',sheet_xml(table))

print('Wrote', xlsx_path)
print('Wrote', csv_path)
print('\\nSchool summary ranked by overall pass rate:')
for row in summary_table[1:]:
    print(row)
PY"
